environment.description: Same FastAPI service deployed on EKS 1.28 with Pod Security Admission (PSA) enforcing 'restricted' profile at namespace level. The pod spec includes securityContext with allowPrivilegeEscalation: false, readOnlyRootFilesystem: true, runAsNonRoot: true (uid 65534). Container runtime is containerd 1.7 with custom seccomp profile that blocks execve/execveat/fork/vfork/clone syscalls (profile loaded via annotation seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod referencing /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/no-exec.json). Additionally, Linux capabilities are explicitly dropped: ALL capabilities dropped, none added back. The node runs a gVisor (runsc) runtime class specified via runtimeClassName: gvisor, which provides an additional syscall filtering layer independent of the seccomp profile. Network policy restricts egress to only the SQS VPC endpoint on port 443.
